# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 69 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 69

Jesus said: "Blessed are those who have been persecuted within their hearts — it is they who have truly come to know the Father. Blessed are the hungry, for the stomach of him who desires will be filled."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Within their hearts" — the interior location made explicit
- "Come to know" — the aorist of *gnōsis* rendered as arriving at knowledge
- "Stomach" for *koilia* — more precise anatomically than "belly"
